# Do your foreign accounts trigger an FBAR or a Form 8938?

> Free FBAR (FinCEN 114) and Form 8938 checker for US citizens, green card holders and expats with foreign accounts: add your accounts, convert currencies and see which filings the thresholds trigger. Nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

## Pages

- [The tool](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/fbar-8938-checker/)
